description: Optimized local serving engine for Kimi-Linear-48B: INT4 quantizer, fused decode kernels for a measured 3.18x, and an OpenAI-compatible server. Ships with k3, a bridge that detects the client per request so Claude Code, Codex, Cline, Aider and opencode all work unchanged.
